description: You are a technical director at an animation studio preparing content for European broadcast. The walk cycle animation at /home/ga/OpenToonz/samples/dwanko_run.tnz must be delivered in PAL broadcast format: 720x576 pixels at 25 frames per second. The studio's current project file uses NTSC settings (wrong frame rate and resolution for European TV). Reconfigure the scene for PAL specifications and render the full animation as a PNG frame sequence to /home/ga/OpenToonz/output/pal_delivery/. Deliver at least 25 frames.
